name: GC-Long (Gaussian Channel breakout)
description: Gaussian Channel hlc3 N=4 period=144 mult=1.414; LONG close x-over hband / exit x-under hband

config.slippage_note: Slippage is NOT simulated (engine limitation) — set to 0; live fills will be slightly worse.
config.fills: signals on bar close, orders fill next bar open (TV process_orders_on_close=false)
config.max_drawdown_basis: max_drawdown_pct = NAV mark-to-market (reproduce from nav_curve); max_drawdown_pct_realized = closed-trade running_equity curve
config.correlation_caveat: All 5 pilots share the Curated-9 universe and are long trend/breakout strategies — they draw down together in a crypto bear. Distinct by logic/timing, not market.
